create_masking_schedule: create a MaskingSchedule with data shape and cosine noise schedule type for diffusion
build_md4_diffusion_model: build an MD4 masked discrete diffusion model with configurable layers, heads, and vocab size
run_md4_training_loss: run the MD4 model __call__ to compute diffusion, reconstruction, and prior losses
sample_md4_ancestral: sample from an MD4 model using ancestral sampling with per-step noise and unmasking
sample_md4_topp: sample from an MD4 model using top-p masked sampling with configurable temperature threshold
